result.summary: Found 3 issues: a loading spinner stuck in the featured hero card, a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, and low-contrast timing badges over images.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, overlapping the food photo — the image appears stuck in a loading state rather than fully rendered.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the hero image finishes loading or gracefully hide the spinner once loaded; add a timeout fallback placeholder.

issues.description: The third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off at the right edge of the 'Fastest near you' carousel, so the full name (likely 'Trattoria Piccola') is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, or ensure card widths/carousel spacing prevent truncation of restaurant names.

issues.description: Delivery time badges (e.g., '15–25 min') use small white text on semi-transparent dark backgrounds over photos, which may have poor contrast on lighter image areas.
issues.suggestion: Increase badge background opacity or text weight/size to keep the badge legible over any image.
